annotations.title: Get the relationship between two types

description: Explain the relationship between two personality types: the relation's name, tagline and category, a sentence saying which side each type is on, the opening of Typeza's article on it, the relation page (relationship_url), the full article for this pair (pair_url) and a disclaimer. Call it when the person asks how two types get along, for example themselves and a partner, friend or colleague. Accepts Typeza names, slugs or codes; outputs use Typeza names, and the relation is read from type_a's side. Duality is the relation for partners and friends; when the question is about work, talk about business relations. This describes typical patterns between types, not advice or a prediction for a real relationship: always pass on the disclaimer.
